import base64,hashlib,io,json,pathlib,subprocess,zipfile
src=pathlib.Path('products/invoice-preflight'); out=pathlib.Path('products/distribution'); out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
names=['index.html','offline-checker.js','STRUCTURE-CHECK.md','sample.csv','offline-test-results.json','structure-test-results.json']
manifest=[]; stream=io.BytesIO()
with zipfile.ZipFile(stream,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
 for name in names:
  p=src/name
  if p.is_file():
   raw=p.read_bytes(); manifest.append({'path':str(p),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}); archive.writestr(name,raw)
assert manifest
check=subprocess.run(['node','--check',str(src/'offline-checker.js')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
assert check.returncode==0
raw=stream.getvalue()
(out/'invoice-preflight-review.zip.base64.txt').write_text(base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii'))
(out/'bundle-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'kind':'HOST_VALIDATION packaging recovery','files':manifest,'archive_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'archive_encoding':'base64','syntax_check_exit':check.returncode,'limits':['No browser or accounting import test performed. Historical test reports are not newly reproduced tests. No publication, sale or revenue is claimed.']},indent=2))
